summary.description: Two to five sentences on the change and the verdict, for the review body.

reason.description: With escalate: what a person has to decide and why. Otherwise empty.

pr_number.description: The PR the finding belongs to (one of a stack).

path.description: File path relative to the repo root, as in the PR diff.

line.description: Line in the new version of the file, inside a hunk of that PR's diff.

blocking.description: true only for what must change before the merge: a bug, a broken contract, a missing check, a security problem.

body.description: The comment: what is wrong, why it matters and what to do.
